# SuspiciousReturn

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `SuspiciousReturnInspection`

A `return` inside a `finally` block discards whatever the `try` block was
doing on its way out: its own return value is replaced and any exception in
flight is swallowed. When the `try` block itself returns or throws, this is
almost always a bug.

## Example

```php{9,19}
<?php
function load($path) {
    try {
        if (!is_file($path)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException($path);
        }
        $data = file($path);
    } finally {
        return null;
    }
}

function fetch($id) {
    try {
        foreach ([$id] as $k) { return $k; }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
    } finally {
        $cleanup = function () { return true; };
        return;
    }
}

function quiet() {
    try {
        work();
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        return 1;
    } finally {
        return 0;
    }
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 9: Returning from &#39;finally&#39; discards the try block&#39;s return value or exception.</li>
<li>line 19: Returning from &#39;finally&#39; discards the try block&#39;s return value or exception.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SuspiciousReturn": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SuspiciousReturn

/**
 * @noinspection SuspiciousReturnInspection
 */
```
